details:
I mostly play the game to hang out with my best friend who is Deaf, it would be nice to have a lanyard in place for deaf, Deaf, hard of hearing, blind, or low vision people. (other suggestions are welcome). For vrchat players that have a disability it would be alot better if the game had these as an option so that anyone can have a lanyard on any avatar instead of it being bound by only people that can use unity.

For example, most of the Deaf people i have played the game with and met, grew up Deaf or with language deprivation so english isn't their strongest language asl is. they often don't know how to use unity due to the complex language used and the weird wording and often need help or guidance from people in the community either through accessible videos or someone just telling them what to do or doling it for them through AnyDesk.

And this doesn't account for the many players that don't even have a computer and can't use unity to add one themselves even if they know how, as those people would need to have someone else upload it on their behalf which would require giving them their account information.

Ultimately though these should be added so people can have an accessory on them that shows if they have a disability that changes the way they play the game and or interact with others. it'd be very useful for other people to know if someone is Deaf or / and Blind just by looking at them so they can change how they interact with them in a way that makes the experience better and easier for everyone involved but of course, the most important thing is that it makes things better for the person with the disability.
title: Want a free lanyard accessories for the Deaf / deaf / HoH / Blind / Low vision / Etc.
